explanation: Exactness requires I'/I=(Q_x-P_y)/P=-3/y, giving I(y)=1/y³ for y≠0. Multiplying by this factor gives (x/y²)dx+(-x²/y³-3)dy=0, which is the differential of x²/(2y²)-3y. Thus the general solution is x²/(2y²)-3y=c. The tested skill is solving an inexact ordinary differential equation using an integrating factor, absent from the supplied course topics, so it is prerequisite.
